description: For a preview that deploy_app deployed without an account: returns the claim link to give to the person, the preview link, and when the preview is deleted if nobody claims it. Opening the claim link and signing in makes the app theirs.

edit_token.description: The edit_token deploy_app returned when it deployed a preview without an account. It is a secret: keep it in this conversation only.

name: get_claim_link
title: Get a preview's claim link
